messages:
Maya Chen: dropping a couple mockups for the Deployments history panel — compact + expanded modes. main asks: density, mobile tap targets, rollback CTA placement, canary slider copy, and keyboard/ARIA checks. PTAL :eyes: Aaron Patel: compact looks nice visually, but touch targets look small — remember 44px min. can we increase hit area on version chips without breaking the layout? Priya Singh: quick copy nit: instead of a lone 'Rollback' CTA, can we use 'Rollback to this version' and show the timestamp under it? also we should surface what happens to in-flight requests (abort vs finish). Liam O'Connor: UX idea — make rollback 2-step: (1) confirm version + impact estimate, (2) final confirm. and a small 'preview' toggle for canaries so you can route only your session to the canary before rolling to traffic. Zoe Brooks: accessibility notes: the canary badge color fails contrast at small sizes (needs 4.5:1 for normal text). keyboard focus ring disappears when timeline is horizontally scrollable — focus-visible must stay. also ensure timeline items announce version + status to screen readers. Maya Chen: putting an aria snippet here for the timeline list — thoughts on semantics? ```html
``` Aaron Patel: probably avoid raw
